title: Intermittent payment timeouts
summary: Checkout requests timed out in bursts while the Payment API waited on saturated database connections.
resolution: Increased the database connection pool max from 20 to 100 and restarted Payment API after the config change.

title: Payment failures caused by expired external API credentials
summary: Payment authorization calls started failing after the fictional-pay API key passed its expiry date.
rootCause: External payment-provider API credentials had expired.
resolution: Rotated the fictional-pay API key and updated the Payment API credential reference.

title: Payment latency caused by third-party payment-provider degradation
summary: Checkout latency followed a degradation on the primary payment provider while database metrics stayed normal.
resolution: Failed over to the backup payment provider and left the circuit breaker open until the primary provider recovered.

title: Login failures after certificate rotation
summary: Clients could not complete TLS handshakes after a certificate rotation because the service still trusted the previous certificate.
symptoms: mobile clients unable to refresh tokens
rootCause: The trust store still referenced the previous TLS certificate after rotation.
resolution: Published the new certificate fingerprint and rolled the Authentication Service.

title: Session validation latency spike
summary: Session lookups slowed sharply even though CPU and error rates stayed flat.
rootCause: The sessions collection had no index on userId.
resolution: Added an index on sessions.userId and confirmed lookup latency returned to baseline.

title: Email delivery backlog after queue misconfiguration
summary: Notification emails queued up after a deploy left workers idle and dead-letter routing disabled.
rootCause: Queue prefetch was set to 1 and dead-letter routing was disabled after a config deploy.
resolution: Restored worker prefetch to 20 and re-enabled dead-letter routing.
